source.primary_witnesses: Aramaic DSS fragments (4Q201-4Q207; late 3rd c. BCE through 1st c. BCE) where preserved; Greek Akhmim Panopolitanus (6th c. CE) where Aramaic absent; Ge'ez (medieval; the only complete witness) as fallback
source.transliteration_convention: Scholarly conventions: Aramaic Imperial-Aramaic transliteration per Milik 1976 (ḥ ṣ ʿ ḫ); Greek SBL convention (η→ē, ω→ō, θ→th, etc., matching Matthew precedent); Ge'ez SBL Ge'ez convention (ḫ ḫ̣ ʾ ʿ ä for ä-vowel)
source.verificationStatus: best-effort reconstruction; verification pending against Milik 1976 DJD apparatus + Nickelsburg 2001 Hermeneia + original codicology
source.fetchedFrom: Milik 1976 The Books of Enoch + Black 1985 Greek text + Charles 1912 Ge'ez PD + Knibb 1978 Ge'ez critical edition + Nickelsburg 2001 Hermeneia commentary
source.citation: Milik 1976 The Books of Enoch (Oxford); Black 1985 The Book of Enoch or 1 Enoch (SVTP 7, Leiden); Nickelsburg 2001 1 Enoch 1 Hermeneia; Charles 1912 The Book of Enoch (Oxford, PD); Knibb 1978 The Ethiopic Book of Enoch (Oxford); Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000 DJD XXXVI; VanderKam 1984 Enoch and the Growth of an Apocalyptic Tradition.
source.paleography_note: CHAPTER 24 — SEVEN MOUNTAINS + TREE OF LIFE (PARADISIACAL MOUNTAIN) — Aramaic 4Q204 1 viii-ix partial (preserves seven-mountains language); Greek Akhmim 24:1-6 substantially complete; Ge'ez full. Michael as guide. **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS COSMIC-MOUNTAIN + TREE-OF-LIFE CLUSTER SITE.**

verses.text_greek: Καὶ ἐκεῖθεν ἀπῆλθον εἰς ἄλλον τόπον τῆς γῆς, καὶ ἔδειξέν μοι ὄρος πυρός, ὃ νυκτὸς καὶ ἡμέρας ἀνῆπτεν.
verses.translit: Kai ekeithen apēlthon eis allon topon tēs gēs, kai edeixen moi oros pyros, ho nyktos kai hēmeras anēpten.
verses.text_geez: ወእምህየ፡ ሖርኩ፡ ውስተ፡ ካልእ፡ መካን፡ ዘምድር፡ ወአርአየኒ፡ ደብረ፡ እሳት፡ ዘሌሊተ፡ ወመዐልተ፡ ይነድድ፡
verses.notes: Mountain of fire burning day and night — transition from ch 23's fire-of-west motif.

verses.text_greek: Καὶ ἐπορεύθην πρὸς αὐτὸ καὶ εἶδον ἑπτὰ ὄρη ἔνδοξα, πάντα τὰ μὲν διαφέροντα ἀλλήλων, λίθων ἐντίμων καὶ ὡραίων, ἔνδοξα ἐν εἴδει καὶ ὡραῖα τὴν ὄψιν· τρία πρὸς ἀνατολὰς ἓν ἐπὶ τοῦ ἑνὸς ἐστηριγμένον, καὶ τρία πρὸς νότον ἓν ἐπὶ τοῦ ἑνός, καὶ φάραγγες βαθεῖαι, μήτε ἐγγίζουσαι ἀλλήλαις.
verses.translit: Kai eporeuthēn pros auto kai eidon hepta orē endoxa, panta ta men diapheronta allēlōn, lithōn entimōn kai hōraiōn, endoxa en eidei kai hōraia tēn opsin; tria pros anatolas hen epi tou henos estērigmenon, kai tria pros noton hen epi tou henos, kai pharanges batheiai, mēte engizousai allēlais.
verses.text_geez: ወሖርኩ፡ ኀቤሁ፡ ወርእኩ፡ ሰብዐተ፡ አድባረ፡ ክቡራነ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ እንዘ፡ ይትሌለዩ፡ በበይናቲሆሙ፡ ዘእምክቡራት፡ ወሥቡሓት፡ አእባን፡ ክቡራነ፡ በራእይ፡ ወሥቡሓነ፡ በራእይ፡ ሠለስቱ፡ መንገለ፡ ጽባሕ፡ አሐዱ፡ ላዕለ፡ አሐዱ፡ ፀኒዐ፡ ወሠለስቱ፡ መንገለ፡ አዜብ፡ አሐዱ፡ ላዕለ፡ አሐዱ፡ ወቈላት፡ ዕሙቃት፡ ኢተቃርቦ፡ በበይናቲሆን፡
verses.witness_secondary: 4Q204 1 viii partial (Milik 1976 pp. 232-235) — Aramaic of seven-mountains revisit
verses.notes: **THE SEVEN MOUNTAINS REVISITED — three east, three south.** Re-elaboration of 18:6-9. Each set stacked one above another. Cross-corpus: revisits the full cosmic-mountain cluster (Mt Nimush, Mt Sapunu, Mt Sinai, Mt Ararat, al-Jūdī, Mt Hermon, Mt Meru, Mt Olympus, Mt Kunlun).

verses.text_greek: Καὶ ἕβδομον ὄρος ἀνὰ μέσον αὐτῶν, ὑπερεῖχεν αὐτοῖς ἐν ὕψει, ὅμοιον καθέδρᾳ θρόνου, καὶ ἐκύκλουν αὐτὸ δένδρα εὐώδη.
verses.translit: Kai hebdomon oros ana meson autōn, hypereichen autois en hypsei, homoion kathedra thronou, kai ekykloun auto dendra euōdē.
verses.text_geez: ወሳብዕ፡ ደብር፡ ማእከለ፡ እሉ፡ የዐቢ፡ እምኔሆሙ፡ በልዕልናሁ፡ ይመስል፡ መንበረ፡ ዐጽፍ፡ ወይዐውድዎ፡ ዕፀው፡ ዘይጥዕም፡ ሕብሎ፡
verses.notes: **THE SEVENTH MOUNTAIN — the central / throne-shaped one, encircled by fragrant trees.** The throne-mountain motif. Cross-corpus: Ezek 28:13-14 ('you were on the holy mountain of God, in the midst of the stones of fire'); Ezek 47 (the trees by the temple river); Rev 22:2 (the tree of life on either side of the river).

verses.text_greek: Καὶ ἐν αὐτοῖς ἦν δένδρον τοιοῦτον οἷον οὐ ἐγὼ οὔπω ὠσφράνθην, καὶ οὐδὲν ἕτερον ἦν αὐτοῦ ὅμοιον· ὀσμὴν ἦν εὐωδέστατος πάντων εὐωδῶν, καὶ τὰ φύλλα αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸ ἄνθος καὶ τὸ ξύλον οὐδέποτε ξηραίνεται· ὁ καρπὸς αὐτοῦ ὡραῖος, ὁ καρπὸς αὐτοῦ ὅμοιος βότρυσιν φοίνικος.
verses.translit: Kai en autois ēn dendron toiouton hoion ou egō oupō ōsphranthēn, kai ouden heteron ēn autou homoion; osmēn ēn euōdestatos pantōn euōdōn, kai ta phylla autou kai to anthos kai to xylon oudepote xērainetai; ho karpos autou hōraios, ho karpos autou homoios botrysin phoinikos.
verses.text_geez: ወማእከሎሙ፡ ሀሎ፡ ዕፅ፡ ከመዝ፡ ዘኢ፡ ኀወትኩ፡ ሕብሎ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይመስሎ፡ ሕብሉ፡ ይጠዕም፡ እምኵሉ፡ ምዑዛን፡ ወቈጽሉ፡ ወዕንባሉ፡ ወዕፁ፡ ለዘለዓለም፡ ኢይየብስ፡ ወፍሬሁ፡ ሥቡሕ፡ ይመስል፡ አስካለ፡ ተምር፡
verses.notes: **THE TREE OF LIFE — the fragrant, ever-green, date-cluster-bearing tree on the seventh mountain.** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS** — the tree-of-life cluster: Gen 2:9 (the tree of life in Eden); Gen 3:22, 24 (from which Adam is barred); Prov 3:18 (Wisdom as tree of life); Ezek 47:12 (trees with healing leaves by the temple river); Rev 2:7, 22:2, 22:14 (the tree of life in New Jerusalem); cf. Mesopotamian sacred tree iconography; the Norse Yggdrasil. The fragrance-and-eternal-greenness motif is shared across paradisiacal-tree traditions.

verses.text_greek: Τότε εἶπον· Ὡς καλὸν τὸ δένδρον τοῦτο καὶ εὐῶδες, καὶ ὡραῖα τὰ φύλλα, καὶ τὰ ἄνθη αὐτοῦ ὡραιότατα.
verses.translit: Tote eipon; Hōs kalon to dendron touto kai euōdes, kai hōraia ta phylla, kai ta anthē autou hōraiotata.
verses.text_geez: ወእቤ፡ ምንተ፡ ይሤኒ፡ ዝዕፅ፡ ወይጥዕም፡ ሕብሉ፡ ወሥቡሕ፡ ቈጽሉ፡ ወዕንባሉ፡ ሥቡሕ፡ ዐቢይ፡
verses.notes: Enoch's exclamation at the tree's beauty.

verses.text_greek: Τότε ἀπεκρίθη μοι Μιχαὴλ, ὁ εἷς τῶν ἁγίων ἀγγέλων ὁ μετ' ἐμοῦ ὤν, καὶ αὐτὸς αὐτῶν ἡγεῖτο.
verses.translit: Tote apekrithē moi Michaēl, ho heis tōn hagiōn angelōn ho met' emou ōn, kai autos autōn hēgeito.
verses.text_geez: ወአውሥአኒ፡ ሚካኤል፡ አሐዱ፡ እመላእክት፡ ቅዱሳን፡ ዘምስሌየ፡ ሀሎ፡ ወውእቱ፡ ይመርሐ፡ ዚአሆሙ፡
verses.notes: **Michael takes over as guide** from Raguel. Sets up ch 25 explanation.
